definition.complete_token: native decode step + every recurring per-token host cost: encode/prepare, submit, wait, GPU-timestamp epilogue, sample readback, position update, tokenizer decode of the new id, bookkeeping. Sampling is device argmax in the same CB.
definition.prefill_exclusion: Q80 generate_mixed_greedy definition. Prefill = teacher-forced walk of all 11 prompt tokens. Last prefill step emits new-token[0] (first_token_latency). Steady denominator is new-tokens[1..] only. Prompt encode, chat render, session.open, session.reset are request/process-level and are not divided into the per-token wall.
definition.cold_first_step: First step of the first generate in a fresh process is graph-cold (pipeline first-touch). Measured 272.285 ms wall / 142.669 ms GPU. Reported, never averaged into the steady median. After that generate, subsequent first steps are warm (~38 ms).
definition.authority_set: 3 alternating A/B pairs = 6 warm in-process generates after one discarded cold generate. Headline = median of the 6 per-rep medians of per-step complete_wall_ns on decode steps.
definition.gpu_definition: MTLCommandBuffer.GPUEndTime - GPUStartTime after wait; never a CPU-wait proxy.

wall_minus_gpu_named.basis: mean of 6 warm-rep per-step means on the 32-token series, so the parts sum to mean wall

is_33537_gpu_an_honest_proxy_for_wall.why: Two independent gaps. (1) Structural: wait ~= gpu + 0.43 ms is true, but wait is not wall. Host encode of 964 dispatches is 0.89 ms — 67% of wall−gpu. Wall = gpu + 1.23 ms headline (1.33 ms on means). (2) Sample: this locked series GPU is 36.99 ms, not 33.54, at both 32-new and 16-new (G015 length). 33.537 is a different session's GPU median over a different denominator (drop first step only; leftover prefill kept).

instrumentation_does_not_dominate.note: Uninstrumented generate_greedy decode wall is 0.78 ms SLOWER than the instrumented complete wall, not faster. Instant splits do not add the host term.
